notes.title: Tower Wizard to coming to Steam!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! A few weeks ago, I released a prototype of a new game on [url=https://barribob.itch.io/tower-wizard]itch.io[/url].

I am really excited to share that the prototype will become a full game on steam!

As for details, nothing is final right now, but
- I intend to release it within 3-6 months, depending on how long it becomes
- This game will be a much longer version of the prototype I released on itch.io.
- There will be a demo Soon™
- The full game will probably be a paid, but I promise to make it cheap!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3372980/Tower_Wizard

As for Magic Archery, I have small update too.
- Added link to "Tower Wizard"
- Added hotkey "c" to craft targets
- Added option to mute when the game is minimized or unfocused

Thanks for your interest!

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
- Fixed rare issue where resetting the game didn't reset gold
- Updated licenses and credits
- Added pause button (for speedrun purposes)
